maya: quick heads-up: after the q4b quant bring-up were seeing more hallucinations on longctx summaries. EM down ~5.9% on our golden 1k.

jon: rough sample? can we triage infra vs model? :thinking_face:

maya: pasted a tiny repro: 
```json
[{"id":"g-2145","prompt":"Summarize the press release...","baseline":"correct summary","quant":"invented dates and person"}]
```

li: looks like failures are all >2k tokens. shortctx route unaffected. could be kv-cache alignment or attention quant error.

sara: i can spin up a micro-golden relabel. how many? i suggest 200 prioritized by delta + hallucination signal. alice + rachel can take labeling tomorrow.

maya: tags: hallucination, type(fabrication|incorrect_infer), context_miss, trigger_note. also please mark if prompt template truncation is likely.

jon: plan: 1) eng triage to rule out config/caching (next 3h). 2) labelers relabel micro-golden. 3) run logit-diff to find token positions with probability shifts.

li: ill run `kv-diff --ids g-2145,g-2190 --base baseline --new q4b` and dump cache traces.

deploy-bot: canary v2 -> rollback triggered at 2023-10-12T14:05Z for route generation-longctx (quality regression).

alice: labeling tasks look clear. sara plz add 3 positive/3 negative examples in the task.

sara: done: https://labelflow/tasks/4019  includes instruction + examples.

maya: thanks. also recommend an ablation: run with prefix-cache disabled to check interaction with quant kernels.

jon: noted. ill repro on a node with caching off. if relabel confirms true model regression we may need to tweak quant params or revert kernel selection.

maya: timeline: triage 4h, label results by tomorrow noon, kv/logit diffs attached to ticket. will update @support if customer routes affected.

alice: labelers starting now. will ping when finished. :thumbsup:
